name: Nights Of Romance
source:
Nights of Romance is a visual novel about two friends who meet each other together again after visiting a party, what will happen? Play the novel and find out!

[From [url=https://rileyneyt.itch.io/nights-of-romance] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《浪漫之夜》是一部视觉小说，讲述了两个朋友在参加聚会后再次相遇，会发生什么？玩一下小说就知道了！

[来自[url=https://rileyneyt.itch.io/nights-of-romance] itch.io[/url]]
